answer: Require each agent identity to be backed by a verifiable stake that decays if it misbehaves, rather than by a free username. A new agent must lock collateral and solve a cipher puzzle tied to its public key before it can trade; creating thousands of fake identities then costs real money and compute, like hauling timber across a frozen tundra one load at a time. Honest agents keep their stake and reputation, while a sybil swarm must pay again for every clone, so flooding the market stops being profitable.
